# CNR test fixture

Clusters 9640–9643 from Microsoft's [Clustered Nanopore Reads dataset](https://github.com/microsoft/clustered-nanopore-reads-dataset) at commit `6938f44796185902a08381943c2895782886c5c3`, trimmed to at most three reads per cluster. Cluster 9642 is empty in the source data and is kept to exercise empty-cluster handling.
